## `neuro.uint8Array.toSorted`

Instance method on `Uint8Array.prototype`.

> Copies and sorts the array.

## Signatures

```ts
toSorted(input: { uint8Array: <receiver>; compareFn?: (a: number; b: number) => number; prompt?: string }): Promise<Uint8Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint8Array.prototype.toSorted` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
